Hi Suman,

Thank you for the kind words, they mean a lot to the team.

Nothing further is needed from you. As soon as your BS-4 leaves the warehouse you will get the tracking number by email at this address, and you can follow the parcel from there.

If anything comes up once it arrives, just reply here and I will pick it up.

Best regards,
Sarah H. Support
